workbook.source_provenance_assessment: No publisher/source URL or provenance evidence was found in the workbook core properties. Creator metadata is not proof of origin; do not treat the filename or LGD-like content as official authentication.

comparison_policy: State and English district names compared case-insensitively with whitespace normalization. District matching is state-qualified. No fuzzy matching, alias inference, code inference, or coordinate inference. Existing approved crosswalk aliases are recognized only when their state/district LGD IDs, official English name, version, and evidence agree with a unique workbook record.
